annotations.title: Resolve what a URL or @handle points at

description: Turn a profile URL, post URL, website or @handle into what socially would read: the platform, the kind (profile, post, website), the normalized handle and the one canonical URL. No egress, no credit. Use it to validate input before a metered lookup.

input.description: A profile URL, post URL, website or @handle.

platform.description: Required when `input` is a bare handle.

name: resolve_target
title: Resolve what a URL or @handle points at
